lines.text: The canister has a Site Zero stamp. Vantongeren calls the template her original. Keep her claim beside the record, not in place of it.
Okafor returns quietly in your record. She says she asks about the dreams. What she keeps private is hers to keep.
No origin appears in the lineage index you copied. That is a gap in a record. It is not a diagnosis.
Four willing templates reach the clinic in your record. Their recall tags enter its register. Care and registration both have consequences.
The clinic offers care. The alternatives are on the record. Read them before you promise anyone a destination.
Sablier made you. Sablier can make you better. Card's on the desk.
Sablier made you. That doesn't mean a card chooses your work. Read it yourself.
